content: For non-package research repos: pyproject.toml with PEP 735 [dependency-groups] is the 2025+ standard — uv supports it natively (docs.astral.sh) and pip >=25.1 supports pip install --group (current pip 26.2.1, option verified in official pip docs). uv.lock provides exact reproducibility; requirements.txt remains fine as exported convenience artifact for pip-only users.
